## Batch 4 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 4 resolves 13 longstanding electrical transcription mystery puzzles from the 1947–1948 syndicated series ***Five Minute Mysteries***. Circulating in collector circles under fragmented tape labels like `"Broken Window"` or `"Alice Killed"`, neural Whisper speech recognition extracted the core challenge clues and narrator prompts to match the syndication matrix registers.
